subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black-hole remain a separate bug investigation after the in-process lane-guard PR, and what recovery boundary should OpenClaw require before later same-lane updates drain?
rationale: Source evidence proves overlapping guarded-lane behavior, but the durable per-topic black-hole path is not isolated enough for automation to choose between clearing persisted state, hard-stopping old work, or preserving lane serialization.

options.title: Keep Separate Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical persistent topic-specific failure and require live or durable-state proof before closing or implementing recovery.

options.title: Fold Into Guarded-Lane Work
options.body: Treat the open guarded-lane PR or its replacement as owning this issue too, but only after it proves post-restart forum-topic recovery.

options.title: Defer Until New Logs
options.body: Leave the stale marker but require fresh redacted logs or state dumps before any maintainer design decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical persistent topic-specific failure and require live or durable-state proof before closing or implementing recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass ties the relevant spool, replay, and dedupe behavior most strongly to prior Telegram recovery work by this contributor.
